title: Horizon arc into prompt bar and generated image
summary: A mark on black, then a lit planet rim rises under it and folds into a glowing prompt bar. A request is typed, a cursor sends it, the result grows out of the send button to full bleed, and a wipe returns to the mark.
use_when: An AI tool that turns a typed prompt into a visual result (image, design, video)
A short launch teaser where the brand moment and the product moment share one shot
Dark, premium brands with one accent colour that can carry a glow
Silent autoplay: the typed prompt explains the product without VO

look.type_style: humanist sans, regular weight, sentence case wordmark ~6 % H beside the mark; prompt text small ~2 % H, light grey

sfx.event: rim lights on under the mark
result card expands to full bleed

structure.shot: white mark alone, centred high on pure black
structure.camera: locked-off; the mark itself turns ~8 deg/s and shrinks slightly (motion.json 0-1 s rot 8.25)
structure.motion: mark rotation easings.outQuint over 23 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: mark slides left as the wordmark types in beside it; a huge black disc with a white-hot violet rim rises below
structure.camera: locked-off; mark drifts left ~0.1 W, rim rises 0.012 H
structure.motion: rim light-on 12 fr ease-out (measured f21-f33), rise 0.600 H -> 0.588 H over 18 fr; wordmark typed ~14 cps; mark slide easings.outExpo 12 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the disc flattens and shrinks into a wide pill: its rim becomes the glowing border of a prompt bar with placeholder
structure.camera: locked-off; lockup lifts ~0.05 H as the pill forms
structure.motion: arc -> pill shape morph springs.layout 12-15 fr (overshoot not measurable); placeholder fades in after the pill settles

structure.shot: lockup and prompt bar hold; the frame travels so the bar runs off the right edge, placeholder clears
structure.camera: dolly right with push-in ~1.00 -> 1.15 over 23 fr (motion.json 320 px/s, 19.7 %/s)

structure.shot: an image request of ~5 words is typed into the bar; mic and round send button appear at the right end
structure.camera: dolly back left following the caret (motion.json -223 then -100 px/s)
structure.motion: prompt typed ~25 cps in one burst 2.77-4.00; send button scales in springs.ui ~10 fr (±0.25 s); hold 0.77 s

structure.shot: frame pushes toward the send end of the bar, lockup leaves left; a pointer cursor enters and clicks send
structure.motion: cursor path springs.ui ~15 fr into the button (±0.25 s), press springs.click; button turns into a white rounded square

structure.shot: a rounded card grows out of the send button; the generated landscape image fades in inside it, glowing border
structure.motion: card scale-in springs.pop ~15 fr from the button (overshoot not measurable); image opacity 0 -> 1 over ~15 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the image card expands from its spot to fill the whole frame, rounded corners flatten
structure.motion: card expand easings.inOutSine 15 fr (soft 7.13-7.63 from cuts.json)

structure.shot: full-bleed image; a small translucent pill with a 3-word tagline drops from the top to centre
structure.motion: tagline pill slides down springs.ui ~15 fr (±0.25 s), then holds 1.2 s

structure.shot: the image breaks into coarse pixel blocks, then a light grey plate covers it from the top
structure.camera: locked-off; image blocks coarsen, plate travels down
structure.motion: pixelate steps every ~3 fr (±0.25 s); plate wipe easings.inExpo ~6 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: plate wipes off upward revealing black with the mark centred, small
structure.motion: plate exit easings.outExpo ~8 fr (±0.25 s); mark scales in springs.snappy (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: wordmark types in beside the mark; lockup holds centred, grey
structure.motion: wordmark typed ~14 cps in ~7 fr per 2 chars; hold 2.0 s, easings.linear push

structure.shot: a dark grey stepped plate creeps in from the lower right while the lockup dims to near black
structure.motion: stepped plate wipe easings.inOutSine ~30 fr; lockup opacity fade ~30 fr

params.brand: any brand.json: mark, wordmark font, fg, accent (rim glow and bar border), bg
params.content.name: wordmark typed beside the mark, twice (open and close)
params.content.placeholder: short placeholder shown in the empty bar
params.content.result: image (or video still) the prompt produces, shown full bleed
params.content.tagline: 3-word line in the pill over the result
params.arc.palette: rim core / glow / atmosphere colours, default from brand accent

notes: Measured by hand on the reference: rim top 0.60 H, radius ~0.39 W, centre ~1.30 H; light-on 12 fr ease-out; rise only 0.012 H over 18 fr, the event is the light. Rim core 4-5 px white, violet falloff to ~90 px. Arc -> pill morph 1.3-1.7 s. Not in vocabulary (see recipe.md Proposed terms): card-expand, pixelate-dissolve, stepped-plate-wipe. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. cut_on_beat 1/2 (soft 7.13 on beat 7.129; hard 9.83 off-beat).
